data.name: S_SentryTelemetry_Enabled_D
data.value: Upload crash, log, trace, and performance data; this does not control online status reporting; when enabled, this data is sent to SecRandom (the upstream project and its organization SECTL), not to this fork

data.name: S_OnlineStatus_Mode_D
data.value: The client reports only the device identifier and device type, and the service derives location from the request address, so no IP or city is sent; choosing off disables online-status reporting entirely; when enabled, this data is also sent to SecRandom and SECTL

data.name: M_SectlEgressOff
data.value: Not disabled: the cross-border notice and the individual online switches apply

data.name: M_SectlEgressOn
data.value: Disabled: every SECTL network feature is unavailable

data.name: S_SectlEgress_Switch_D
data.value: Turns off every feature that connects to SecRandom / SECTL servers: proof attestation, formal notarization, announcements, online status, usage counters, version reporting, account sign-in, device heartbeat, and cloud backup; the switch is stored on this device and is not affected by importing or restoring settings, and while it is on the cross-border notice and the individual online switches no longer take effect
